name: Ride It Out
source:
After a long day of packing to move out of town, your partner wants to wind down at her favorite place: the local carnival. It's not too crowded, so no one would mind if you both stayed on the teacup ride THAT long.

[From [url=https://momosa-frog.itch.io/ride-it-out]itch.io[/url]]
